releaseNotes:
v6.0.0 — Queue overhaul, lyrics polish, developer hub:

Queue:
• Playing a song from search results no longer turns the entire result list into your queue — it starts a fresh single-track session
• Stable (non-shuffle) mode now behaves like a real playlist: 'Next up' shows your queue in order with no radio suggestions mixed in
• Shuffle mode keeps YouTube-style 'Up next' radio suggestions

Player:
• Restored separate Shuffle and Repeat buttons on the player
• Removed the video toggle — YouTube stopped serving playable video URLs, so it only produced dead ends

Lyrics:
• Synced lyrics no longer drop lines with [mm:ss] timestamps (fraction-less LRC timestamps are now supported)
• The active lyric line now centres in the viewport instead of sticking to the top edge under the header

Settings:
• New developer credit section at the bottom with profile, Instagram (@israrxy), GitHub (@israrxy) and website (israrxy.qzz.io) links

What's next:
• This release marks the clean-up milestone — expect stability improvements before any new features
